title: Cleanup of Kanlaon debris in Negros town starts Dec. 1

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – The extraction and hauling of lahar deposits from Ibid Creek in Barangay Biaknabato, La Castellana, Negros Occidental will begin on Tuesday, Dec. 1, Provincial Environment and Management Office (PEMO) head Julie Ann Bedrio announced on Friday, Nov. 27. Based on their letters of intent, eight private haulers will remove 41,060 cubic meters of volcanic debris, part of the estimated 67,530 cubic meters of total lahar deposits assessed in the area, she said.
